title: Call end to activeCallId clear is non-atomic
description: When VTCCall transitions to ended: must set VTCCall.state='ended', clear Chat.activeCallId to null, dispatch VTCCallEndEvent, deliver StateChange for both types. Four writes across two data types. In distributed systems, clients see stale activeCallId after receiving VTCCallEndEvent, or get Chat StateChange before VTC StateChange. No ordering guarantee or retry semantics specified.
